description: Structural deep copies preserve internal resolution metadata, including syntactic numeric kind (integer vs. float), until resolution and final validation are complete: a float that looks like an integer (1000.0) still serializes via the canonical float rule ('1000') after being deep-copied twice and then interpolated.
input:
a:
  x: 1000.0
copy1: ($a)
copy2: ($copy1)
label: Value is ($copy2.x).
